 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result, Expected Date & Merit List
 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result is expected to be released by the Union Public Service Commission in late November or early December 2026 . Following the completion of the Personality Tests on October 30, 2026, candidates can soon check the ESE 2026 Final Merit List PDF on upsc.gov.in.

 What After UPSC ESE Final Result 2026? 
 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result: The UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result is expected to be declared in late November or early December 2026 . Conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), the Engineering Services Examination (ESE), commonly referred to as the Indian Engineering Services (IES) exam, recruits Group-A officers across Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics & Telecommunication engineering disciplines.
 While the Commission has not yet officially confirmed the exact declaration date, the final result will be published online shortly after the conclusion of the Personality Test phase. 
 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result Date
 Based on the completion of the interview schedule on October 30, 2026, the UPSC Engineering Services Final Result 2026 is anticipated between the last week of November and the first week of December 2026. Historically, UPSC compiles category-wise scores from all examination stages within three to five weeks after the final interview board concludes.
 Note that the date below is projected based on current recruitment developments and has not been officially notified by the Commission.

 UPSC ESE Final Result 2026 PDF Download Link
 UPSC releases the UPSC ESE Result 2026 PDF exclusively in digital format on its official web portal. The document contains the roll numbers and names of candidates recommended for appointment across participating central government ministries, including Central Water Engineering, Central Power Engineering, Indian Defence Service of Engineers, and Border Roads Engineering Service.

 How to Download UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result?
 Once the Commission activates the result link on its server, candidates can access their selection status by following these steps:
 Visit the Official Portal: Go to the official Union Public Service Commission website at [https://upsc.gov.in/](https://upsc.gov.in/).
 Locate the Results Tab: Navigate to the Examinations menu on the homepage and click on Final Results, or check the What's New ticker on the right side.
 Select the Notification: Click on the link titled " Engineering Services Examination, 2026 – Final Result ".
 Open the Document: The UPSC ESE Result 2026 PDF will open in a new browser tab.
 Save a Copy: Click the download icon to save the file locally for future document verification stages.
 Verify Selection Status: Press Ctrl + F (or Command + F on Mac) and enter your seven-digit roll number or full name to verify if you are on the recommended list.
 Candidates selected through UPSC ESE can explore career opportunities in Government Departments Hiring Through UPSC ESE , including services related to railways, defence, power, telecommunications and infrastructure. 
 Details Mentioned on UPSC ESE 2026 Merit List
 The official ESE 2026 Final Merit List document serves as the formal recommendation press note from the Commission. Candidates should carefully verify the following details inside the PDF:
 Roll Number: The unique identification number assigned to the candidate for the 2026 exam cycle.
 Name of Recommended Candidates: Full name as registered during the One-Time Registration (OTR) and Detailed Application Form (DAF) submission.
 Discipline-Wise Classification: Segregation of UPSC ESE 2026 Selected Candidates across Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering.
 Merit Order / Rank: The All India Rank (AIR) determining priority during cadre and department allocation.
 Provisional Status: Roll numbers marked with an asterisk or listed separately whose candidature remains provisional pending verification of original certificates.
 Vacancy & Reserve List Summary: Breakdown of total vacancies reported by the government (474 posts for 2026) and instructions regarding the consolidated reserve list.
 UPSC ESE 2026 Selection Process
 The Engineering Services Examination Final Result reflects cumulative performance across a rigorous three-tier evaluation spanning 1,300 marks:
 Stage I – Preliminary Examination (500 Marks): An objective-type screening test consisting of Paper-I (General Studies and Engineering Aptitude for 200 marks) and Paper-II (Engineering Discipline for 300 marks).
 Stage II – Main Examination (600 Marks): A conventional, descriptive written examination comprising two discipline-specific papers of 300 marks each. Candidates qualifying both Stage I and Stage II (1,341 candidates qualified in the July 2026 Mains result) advance to the final round.
 Stage III – Personality Test / Interview (200 Marks): A board interview assessing leadership, technical clarity, mental alertness, and suitability for public service.
 The final merit list is compiled strictly by aggregating marks obtained across all three stages out of 1,300.
 UPSC Engineering Services 2026 Final Merit List
 The ESE 2026 Final Merit List represents the official list of candidates recommended by UPSC to the Government of India for Group-A technical appointments. Inclusion in the merit list does not automatically guarantee immediate appointment; rather, it signifies that the candidate has cleared the cut-off criteria for their respective category and engineering branch.
 Service and department allocation depends on three primary factors:
 Final Merit Rank: Higher-ranked candidates receive top priority for their preferred cadres.
 Service Preferences: The order of department preferences submitted by the candidate in their Detailed Application Form (DAF).
 Medical & Eligibility Standards: Meeting the physical standards prescribed by the Railway Board and respective ministries for specific engineering services.
 The direct merit list PDF link will be embedded in this section immediately after UPSC publishes the official document.
 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result Marks
 UPSC does not release individual scorecards on the exact day the final result PDF is published. Following standard protocol, the Commission uploads the detailed mark sheets of both recommended and non-recommended candidates within 15 days of declaring the UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result.
 Once the scorecard link goes live on upsc.gov.in, candidates can view their stage-wise marks (Prelims Paper 1 & 2, Mains Paper 1 & 2, and Personality Test marks) by logging in with their Registration ID / Roll Number and Date of Birth. The scorecards remain active on the portal for a limited window of 30 days.
 What After UPSC ESE Final Result 2026?
 Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the UPSC ESE 2026 Selected Candidates list transition from the examination phase to the administrative onboarding process managed by the Ministry of Railways (the nodal ministry for ESE) and respective cadre-controlling authorities:
 Document Verification & Eligibility Checks: Original certificates verifying educational qualifications (B.E./B.Tech degree), age, and category claims (EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwBD) are scrutinized. Candidates with provisional status must clear their pending documentation within the stipulated deadline.
 Medical Examination: Candidates are assigned to designated railway or government hospitals for a comprehensive medical board checkup to confirm fitness for technical field duties.
 Service Allocation: Based on merit rank, category vacancies, medical fitness, and DAF preferences, the nodal ministry publishes the final cadre allocation list.
 Offer of Appointment & Training: Respective ministries issue formal appointment letters, instructing new recruits to report to their designated central training institutes (such as NAIR Vadodara, IRICEN Pune, or NPTI) for foundation and departmental training.
 Aspirants planning for the next cycle should check the UPSC ESE 2027 Exam Date , UPSC ESE 2027 notification details , and UPSC ESE Prelims High-Weightage Topics to plan their preparation effectively. 
 UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result FAQs
 Which government departments recruit candidates through UPSC ESE?
 UPSC ESE recruits candidates for services such as Central Engineering Service, IDSE, Indian Railway Management Service, Central Power Engineering Service and Indian Telecommunication Service. Which engineering branches are eligible for UPSC ESE?
 UPSC ESE includes four engineering branches: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Does UPSC ESE offer Group A Gazetted Officer posts?
 Yes, several services recruited through UPSC ESE offer Group A Gazetted Officer positions in central government departments. Q4. Will UPSC release the ESE 2026 marks along with the final result?
 No, individual scorecards are not released alongside the result PDF. UPSC typically publishes the detailed marks of both recommended and non-recommended candidates within 15 days after the final result declaration. Table of Content UPSC ESE 2026 Final Result Date
